title: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
summary: A cable triceps extension with your arms overhead, which loads the long head at a stretch.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: cable station with an adjustable pulley.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for triceps (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly triceps total.

setup.text: Face away from a pulley, holding a rope behind your head with your arms overhead.
Stagger your stance and brace your core.
Straighten your arms forward and up.
Let the rope come back slowly behind your head.

form_cues.cue: Get a deep stretch at the bottom of every rep.

mistakes.text: Letting the elbows flare out to the sides.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Less stretch emphasis, Less triceps long-head bias, Peak-contraction focus.

notes: Ratings, swap attributes and cues are the library model (modeled). An authored page will replace this one.
